_comment: Reconciliation snapshot in the 2026-07-04 Fulfillment Outbound order shape (the create/list API version, which is live). Drives the reconciliation agent's CANCEL branch: a top-level line item with a cancelled quantity and no shipments. With getOrderLineList scripted as a Released line (cancelled delta > 0), the agent generates an INTERNAL order-status-changed event (an internal representation used to invoke the processor) and the cancel processor builds the OMS changeRelease request. Sample (non-real) values.
